Purification of Frantic Forest

Cure the forest creatures with your guildmates!

GameplayEvent Rules12 sections
Event Rules

◆ Players need to cooperate with guild members for exploration and challenges in Purification of Frantic Forest.

◆ The goal is to explore and heal infected forest creatures to earn rewards!

Exploration

◆ Exploration requires using Stamina. Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 15 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit.

◆ While exploring, players will encounter Infected monsters and have a small chance of encountering Frantic monsters.

Healing Monsters

◆ Player's Healing Power = Total Fellow Power.

◆ The player's healing power reduces a monster's HP with each healing.

◆ Players earn scores based on the ratio of monster HP reduced with each healing.

Curing Monsters

◆ A monster is cured when its HP goes down to 0.

◆ Players who cures a monster receive additional personal scores.

◆ When a Frantic Monster is cured, the finder of that monster will receive item rewards.

Capturing Monsters

◆ Players can capture monsters and send them back to the guild camp's stables.

◆ All guild members can heal the monsters in the stables.

Targeted Traps

◆ Targeted trapping requires Intricate Traps, which immediately capture 20 monsters.

◆ Players can set their target monsters, significantly increasing the chance of capturing those monsters.

Scores and Coins

◆ Players can earn scores by healing and curing monsters.

◆ Each time a player earn scores, they obtain an amount of coins equal to 2.5% of the scores earned (rounded down). But players can't get Frantic Forest Coins through scores from guild.

◆ For every Bell spent, players earn 1000 coins.

◆ When players earn personal scores, their guild scores increase simultaneously.

Guild Camp

◆ The guild camp can be upgraded by earning guild scores. When a guild camp is upgraded, all the members will receive rewards.

◆ After upgrading a guild camp, players can explore more forest areas, higher-level monsters can be sent to the stables, and the chance of encountering frantic monsters increases.

Stables

◆ The guild camp has several stables that can hold captured monsters.

◆ Monsters will escape after some time in the stables.

◆ The stables have a capacity limit. When this limit is exceeded, newly captured monsters will replace the monsters in the stables, prioritizing the replacement of infected monsters, and among the same monster type, prioritizing those about to escape.

Treasure Dragon

◆ When a guild gets a certain amount of scores, a Treasure Dragon will appear.

◆ Each player in a guild has limited chances to heal a Treasure Dragon, so guild members should work together to do so.

◆ Reward chests will appear in the forest after curing a Treasure Dragon.

◆ The number of reward chests is limited. All guild members can obtain them during exploration.

◆ Daily, the odds of finding a chest is 5% before finding 3 reward chests.

◆ After encountering 3 reward chests on a day, the chance of finding one is 1%.

Masked Dryad

◆ Masked Dryads are one of the monsters that you will encounter in the Frantic Forest.

◆ Each player in a guild has limited chances to heal a Masked Dryad , so guild members should work together to do so.

◆ The guild that contributes the most to healing the Masked Dryad will receive generous rewards.

◆ Guilds that cure a Masked Dryad will receive generous rewards.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ There are two rankings in the event: Overall and daily rankings.

◆ The daily ranking is based on the number of explorations, calculated at 00:00 each day.

◆ The overall ranking is based on scores, calculated at the end of the event.

◆ After the leaderboards have been calculated, rewards can be claimed based on your rank.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be reissued to you in the mail.
